notes.title: The Inspector Arrives
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

welcome to the BETRAYED 0.9.6 update - "The Inspector Arrives".

This update introduces the new Inspector role, allowing deeper investigation of corpses and the collection of evidence that reveals clues about the Traitor. Major systems have been overhauled, including task management, interaction, and item behavior. New items, weapons, and a minigame have been added, alongside enhanced animations, better performance, and a reworked UI. With more tools for strategy and subterfuge, this is BETRAYED’s most ambitious update yet.

[h2]🧑‍💼 New Roles & Classes[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Inspector:[/b] A new playable class has been added. Inspectors can access additional information from dead players and assist in identifying the Traitor.
[/list]

[h2]🔍 Investigation & Evidence System[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Interactive Corpses:[/b] Dead players now spawn an inspectable corpse. All players receive basic info and an image of the deceased. Inspectors see more details. Once reported, the body can no longer be revived or hidden.
[*] [b]Traitor Mechanics:[/b] Traitors can hide corpses and revive other Traitors.
[*] [b]Evidence System:[/b] Evidence can now be collected to reveal clues about the Traitor. Traitors can destroy evidence to hide their identity.
[/list]

[h2]📋 Task System[/h2]
[list]
[*] A task queue system has been introduced for smoother task handling.
[*] New 3D models for Quick-Time Events (QTE).
[*] A new QTE system with key input has been implemented for more interactive tasks.
[/list]

[h2]🔫 Weapons & Items[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Gasoline Bomb (Remote):[/b] Can be placed and remotely detonated.
[*] [b]Snapshot Item:[/b] Transforms you into a targeted player with the option to revert.
[*] [b]Turret:[/b] Automatically shoots other players but not Traitors.
[*] [b]Stone:[/b] A simple throwable item added to the arsenal.
[/list]

[h2]🧍 Character & Animations[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed wall clipping for FPS and TPS characters.
[*] Most weapons now support ADS (Aim Down Sights).
[*] Recoil and spread now respond to movement, crouching, and ADS status.
[*] New animations for recoil, handsway, rechamber, and shell ejection.
[*] New clothing meshes for male and female Inspectors.
[/list]

[h2]🗺️ Maps & Minigames[/h2]
[list]
[*] New lobby maps added.
[*] New minigame: [i]ChickenCross[/i].
[*] Minigames are now connected to an SQL database and store global highscores.
[*] Existing maps have been overhauled and improved.
[/list]

[h2]🧠 AI & Behavior[/h2]
[list]
[*] Chickens and roosters now have updated sound-based behaviors.
[/list]

[h2]💻 System & Performance[/h2]
[list]
[*] Door logic now handled by the door itself, not the player.
[*] Game timer now syncs every 30 seconds; otherwise runs client-side.
[*] New item pickup class with replicated physics and automatic deactivation after settling.
[*] Improved object placement logic; no more wall placement (except for cameras).
[*] Placement now handled client-side for performance.
[/list]

[h2]🎮 Gameplay Mechanics[/h2]
[list]
[*] Interaction system fully reworked for smoother handling.
[*] New locked room requiring four note clues to unlock via keypad.
[*] New QTE with key input and visual feedback.
[*] Drunken input added with visual effects via post-processing.
[*] Running now affects how weapons are visually carried.
[/list]

[h2]🧩 UI & Widgets[/h2]
[list]
[*] New buff and debuff widgets show active status effects.
[*] Improved in-game widgets for all roles.
[*] New post-processing for spyglasses.
[*] Kick Button in Lobby
[/list]

[h2]🛒 Shops & Inventory[/h2]
[list]
[*] New Traitor Shop with category sorting.
[*] Inspector Shop added with useful role-specific items.
[*] Inventory system improved with better validation and structure.
[/list]

[h2]🔧 Technical Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Removed hard references; now using interfaces and soft references from a database.
[*] New, smaller PlayerState class for reduced network load.
[*] New damage type “Punishment” does not count toward total damage.
[*] New shell ejection visual effects.
[*] Backup corpse creation added in case of body spawn failure.
[*] Fixed items and grenades clipping through walls or floors.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 2024.10.09
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Just a quick information about the pushed hotfix.

- We have addressed feedback that the assigned roles are not random in some cases and the same players are traitors for a long time in a row. We hope this hotfix improves this and would love to get your feedback.

- We have also added some small changes to the UI.
The "Blackmarket" info will start to blink if the traitor does not access the market within the first 30 seconds of the game, to make people aware of the option and all the additional weapons available in it.

- Players are now also able to replace a weapon by holding the interaction key (default E). 
The info overlays will also say "Hold E to replace".

- For items (like wood planks and cannonballs) the info overlay will now show "Inventory full" when players can't pick up any additional items.

As always: We are happy to hear your feedback.

Cheers

notes.title: Update 0.8 is live!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

we're back with a bang! After listening to your feedback and working diligently behind the scenes, we're thrilled to present version 0.8. This update brings an exciting rework to the inventory system, new features, fixes, and a host of improvements to elevate your gaming experience.

[h3]🎉 Additions:[/h3]
[b]Inventory System Rework[/b]
[list]
[*] Innocent now has 2 item slots for Medikit, Antidote, Wooden Plank, Keys.
[*] Traitors drop Traitor weapons. Innocents can pick up and use these weapons
[/list]
[b]Water & Drowning System Rework[/b]
[list]
[*] Introduced a new waterplane.
[*] Items now "float" on the waterplane
[*] Certain items sink if too many players stand on them
[*] Added drowning sound effects and visual effects
[*] Players drown when their head is submerged underwater
[/list]
[b]Stamina System[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a stamina system

[/list]
[b]UI[/b]
[list]

[*] New hit indicator with sound
[*] Added nameplates
[*] Added a widget as a marker for items and interactables
[/list]
[b]Map[/b]
[list]
[*] Introduced a new map: Moon Crate
[/list]
[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*] Added treasure chests with Traitor Testers
[*] Added a vault with three different keys containing antidotes or medikits
[*] Added repairables on the map using the new item, Wooden Plank
[*] Added a game server setting for false killing punishment options (100 BC, 200 BC, 300 BC, -50 HP, Death)

[b]Weapons[/b]
Innocent:
[list]
[*] New item: Antidote

Traitor:
[list]

notes.title: Update 0.7 is live!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,
we have been quiet for a while. But quietly working that is!
And what follows after quiet? Noise! Bringing you the Audio update with version 0.7. Not only adding ambiance and music but also a slew of new features, fixes, and changes.

But 'nough with the talking, here are the details this magic download brings:

🎉 Additions:
[list]
[*] Customizer: New category!! Hats, hats everywhere!
[*] Map: Added Arctica map.
[*] Role: Added the VIP role. Innocent: Protect at all cost! Traitor: Kill for some sweet extra BC
[*] Traitor weapon: Sacrifice bomb - One big blow to get 'em all! Sacrifice yourself but if you take everyone with you: you still win.
[*] Traitor weapon: Invisibility - Turn into nothing more than a faint silhouette for 30 secs. and go full stealth mode
[*] Traitor weapon: Rocket launcher - What is there to say?
[*] Traitor weapon: Car gun - A shotgun shooting cars that grow in size. What could go wrong?
[*] Traitor weapon: Silenced sniper - Because shooting from the far is not quite enough!
[*] Audio: Every map now plays background music
[*] Audio: Every map now has ambiance sounds
[*] Settings: Added mouse sensitivity setting (yeeehaaa!!)
[*] Settings: Added full key re-mapping
[*] Gameplay: BC rewards are now immediate and can be used in the same round
[*] Gameplay: Added settings for VIP role.
[*] Gameplay: Added different lobby maps
[*] Gameplay: Map voting can now be deactivated (the game will use selected map order)
[*] Gameplay: Added punishment for innocents killing innocents
[*] Gameplay: Added effect when shooting water.
[*] Gameplay: Added Sniper (with ADS)
[*] Gameplay: Added Shotgun
[*] Gameplay: Added options for traitors to see who is the other traitor
[*] Gameplay: Added ability to select which weapons/traitor weapons to include in the round
[*] UI: All key icons now update according to your mapped keys
[*] UI: BC reward is now shown blow game timer (top of the screen) with a gold indicator for VIP
[*] UI: Spectator mode now offers the option to show the assigned roles of remaining players
[*] UI: Player can now hide the in-game UI for screenshots (this will auto-reset when showing the leaderboard at the round end)
[*] UI: Added proper loading screens on transitions.
[*] UI: Added opening videos for UE and Almost Good Games logos
[*] UI: "Innocent win" will now also show if the VIP survived
[*] UI: Leaderboard now shows the damage each player caused
[/list]


📐 Changes:
[list]
[*] Customizer: Moved shirts to left side to make space for hats
[*] Traitor weapon: added blinking light and small delay to land mine
[*] Settings: In-game audio will be mute on game start and fade in
[*] Gameplay: Creating a new lobby will now pick a random map as starter map
[*] Gameplay: Fall damage is reduced by 25%
[*] Gameplay: Reduced lobby countdown from 120 to 60 seconds.
[*] UI: Chat window in the lobby is now open by default
[*] UI: Game timer now shown when in spectator mode
[*] UI: Showing Traitor/VIP roles in leaderboard
[*] UI: Updated spectator UI to fit with game style
[*] UI: "Vote" button on map voting now transparent until a map is selected to improve how users interact
[*] UI: Voting back to lobby will retain ALL current game settings (bless!)
[*] UI: Leaderboard height now adjusts to the amount of players in it.
[/list]


🛠️ Fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where player clothing and info would sometimes not load on map (infinite loading screen)
[*] Voting back to lobby would cause issues (due to the new changing lobby maps)
[*] Fixed issue where players could not join a new game after getting kicked out of a running one.
[*] Fixed issues with floating objects, transparent objects, and other item issues on various maps
[*] Removed the ability to shoot out the traitor room glass (unfair advantage)
[*] Fixed poison not working (which is something we broke in this update lol)
[*] Fixed some small issues with lobby chat.
[*] Fixed Lobby countdown resetting when new player joins
[*] Fixed land mines not resetting after round ended.
[/list]


📃 Others:
[list]
[*] Reduced game size by almost 60%
[/list]

🪲 Known Issues:
[list]
[*] Doors will not reliably open/close when spamming E
[/list]

Additionally, we want to apologize for not bringing the in-game voice chat with this update as promised.
We tried our best but do not feel like the quality of the voice chat is up to our standard just yet so we will work hard to bring it for the next update. Thanks for your understanding!

We hope these changes improve your experience and are happy to hear any feedback.

Make sure to join our Discord to find other players, leave feedback, and be part of an amazing community!

notes.content:
Hey there, it's Sascha from Almost Good Games!

Our first beta test run is over and boy did it bring some issues to light.
With the update 0.5.3a we are addressing what we can to improve the game fast and enable a better experience for the next test runs.

The update includes the following:

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Player spawn is now random on each map
[*] All Sub-Menus in Main Menu can now be closed with ESC button
[*] Settings in Lobby can be closed with ESC button
[*] Fixed issue with the setting menu not closing anymore
[*] General re-work of the main menu and in-game UI
[*] Fortress: Fixed collision issue with stairs.
[*] Fortress: Fixed collision issue with grass
[*] The Office: Slight performance improvement
[*] Fixed debugging output being shown on some maps
[*] Poison gun now has a shooting sound
[/list]

We also updated the steam store page with more current pictures that reflect the state of the game.

notes.title: Getting ready for the beta!
notes.content:
Whats up everyone it's Sascha from Almost Good Games.

As we are getting ready for beta testing which is starting tonight we are pushing another major update to address some of the bugs and issues we have ran away from so far, as well as adding some of the feature we believe need to be functional for a game run this test.
The exact changes are listed below, as usual

Fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed issue with wrong map names in database
[*] Fortress: Fixed issue with no collision on grass
[*] Fixed player camera clipping through walls
[*] Fixed the collision of spawnable wells
[*] The Office: Fixed collision for power plug
[*] Fixed ability to reload gun when magazine was still full
[*] Fixed issue where vault key did not get deleted from player inventory after round end
[*] Fixed missing collision with train
[*] Fixed traitor tester not showing correct for clients
[/list]


Changes:
[list]
[*] Removed collision for player masks
[*] Aligned server list when joining game
[*] Adjusted leaderboard and map voting times
[*] Cleaner in-game UI + added interaction descriptions
[*] 
[/list]


Additions:
[list]
[*] Added main menu button "Report Bug/Feedback"
[*] Added all needed spawns in lobby
[*] Added loot to vault
[*] Visual UI info when getting shot to indicate damage
[*] Fortress: Added traitor door access
[/list]



We hope these additions will help make the beta test run smooth.
If you are interested to test the game early please join our Discord and let us know!

notes.title: New Features bring new problems
notes.content:
Well... it's us again.

Update 0.5.2 added a ton of new features and sometimes new features also add new issues.

So we are pushing 0.5.2 out right away, addressing some of the issues we identified after testing.
These fixes include:

Fixes:
Fixed weapon sound not being adjusted to volume settings
Fixed weapon collision with wall
Fixed wrong orientation muzzle flash for Deagle
Fixed game breaking issue for client when host closes session
Fixed ability to safe server settings without any map selected
Removed multiple debugging console prints showing in game UI
Fixed sound settings not applying on maps
Pirate Bay: Fixed defective materials
Fixed issue with transitioning to new map after round is over


Changes:
Pirate Bay: Changed vulcano design
Pirate Bay: Changed palm tree color to a more natural color
Global: Adjusted damage for all weapons

Addition:
Added ESC menu to game lobby
Added ESC menu to map vote screen
The Office: Added vault spawner to map
The Office: Added weapon spawner to map


That's it for now.
Please leave your feedback as usual

notes.title: Build 0.5.1 is out!
notes.content:
Hi everyone, it's Sascha from Almost Good Games!

We are excited to push our first update to steam bringing major improvements to Betrayed.
This has been exciting for us as we are getting used to all the tech behind steams platform and it's update process!

So whats actually new? Lets dive into it and look at the fixes, additions, and changes:


[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Colt muzzle flash in wrong orientation
[*] Fixed glitching through ceiling when crouching while jumping
[*] Fixed server settings not updating when joining later into the lobby
[*] High Noon: Traitor door not opening low enough for player to walk in
[*] The Office: Fixed carpet glitching next to server room
[*] The Office: Fixed glitching floor in bathroom
[*] The Office: Fixed wrong door size on emergency exit
[*] Outlines for intractable objects visible to all players
[*] Fixed "ready" check mark in lobby not showing proper next to player name
[*] Pirate Bay: Fixed tree LOD glitching
[*] Fixed vault being usable by multiple players at once
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] High Noon: Adjusted radius of different sounds
[*] Updated Betrayed logo
[*] The Office: Edited roof layout to enable player to reach upper level
[*] The Office: Fixed performance issue with CCTV camera
[*] Fortress: Removed Kill-Z in favor of new implemented fall damage
[*] Fortress: Changed map post processing
[*] New logo shown in loading screen
[*] The Office: Cars now moving along spline + variation of 12 instead of 4 colors
[*] Removed debugging messages
[/list]

[b]Additions:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added fall damage
[*] Game Settings: "General" and "Map" Setting changes will now be displayed for the clients
[*] "Settings" button in ESC menu now functional.
[*] Added icons for items in character customizer
[*] Added custom cursor style
[*] Added NPC chicken to game + Reset of chicken at round start
[*] Added more game settings
[*] Map queue showing correctly in game lobby
[*] Countdown shown if player is in prison
[*] Option to zoom into head in character customizer
[*] Added key-bind to open traitor menu
[*] Added sound settings into the game
[*] Added map voting system at end of game
[*] Added leaderboard/scoreboard at end of round
[*] Added logic to switch to voted map at end of voting time
[*] Implemented functional Steam account showing in main menu
[*] Implemented ability for traitor to buy and equip traitor tools/weapons
[/list]

[b]Others:[/b]
[list]
[*] Created "The Office" map teaser trailer. Go check that out!
[*] Finally released our official website on www.almostgoodgames.com
[/list]


And that's it for the moment.
Let us know what you think. If you find any bugs or issues, please let us know so we can address these and get another update out as soon as possible.

Happy playing!
